info.name: Physna Public ClientCredentials Image Search API

params.name: id
params.description: The path that gets returned from POST `/images` route; if more than one id is provided, the results will be combined into a single search

params.name: search
params.description: A general string used to search and filter on all matched models.

params.name: filter
params.description: A [`FilterExpression`](#model-FilterExpression). See the [API Reference](https://physna.github.io/public-api-guide/api-reference/filter-expressions) for more details.

params.name: page
params.description: A 1 based page number used in conjunction with `perPage`.

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of items to return per page.

items.docs:
We are continually improving image recognition capabilities. At current state, the following properties are advisable for good performance:
- Images with the object by itself.
- Images with a plain background.
- The color of the object usually does not affect detection outcomes.

**Examples of Images that Perform Well**

![Images that perform well](assets/good_images.png)
- plain background
- object isolated on its own

**Examples of Images to Avoid**

![Images to avoid](assets/bad_images.png)
